title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognised as the go-to expert on cost across the team.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>You will...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop a harmonised cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.</li> <li>Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.</li> <li>Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalisation and consolidation opportunities.</li> <li>Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>You are....</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.</li> <li>Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.</li> <li>A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.</li> <li>Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.</li> <li>Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>You have....</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.</li> <li>Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.</li> <li>Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.</li> <li>Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.</li> <li>Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes<br>Company pension scheme<br>Gym membership<br>Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)<br>Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme<br>Nursery support scheme<br>Cycle to work scheme<br>Group Life Assurance</p> <p><strong>To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in the UK, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time.</strong></p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Hybrid Working Policy</strong><br>We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p><strong>Next steps</strong>: Your application will be reviewed and if successful, a member of the Talent Acquisition Team will be in touch within 2 weeks.</p> <p>You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake. You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager.</p> <h2><strong>We are HelloFresh</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">At HelloFresh we embrace and welcome diversity and we currently employ over 15,000 individuals globally who contribute to this. title: Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><h2>About DTA</h2> <p>DTA is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We bring together technology, data and analytics to help agencies and clients transform the value of data.</p> <p>Our platform, Open Media Studio, is an AI-enabled media and data platform built for the next era of advertising. Our 1,000-plus team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem-solvers works across 20 markets worldwide.</p> <h2>The opportunity</h2> <p>We’re looking for a hands-on <strong>Security Engineer</strong> to help design, build and operate secure cloud platforms, data pipelines and data-sharing solutions. These capabilities support our internal product teams and deliver data to clients—either in client-owned cloud environments or in our own.</p> <p>The role is GCP-first, with security patterns that can be applied across AWS and Azure. You’ll help embed security into infrastructure, identities, data products and AI-enabled services from the start—not bolt it on later.</p> <p>As AI agents connect to data and systems through technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), our security model needs to account for machine identities, tool permissions and automated actions. You’ll help build the controls that make these services safe to use, including authentication, authorisation, monitoring and protection against risks such as prompt injection, tool misuse and data leakage.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Security Operations, Privacy, Legal, Marketing and Client Delivery teams. The goal is to make the secure approach the easiest approach—and to deliver reliable, well-governed data to our clients.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <h3>Secure cloud platforms and automation</h3> <ul> <li>Build and improve secure cloud foundations in GCP, including resource hierarchies, organisation policies, VPC Service Controls, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) and centralised logging.</li> <li>Develop reusable Terraform modules and project factories so teams can provision, test and redeploy secure environments consistently.</li> <li>Apply policy-as-code in CI/CD, use keyless pipelines through workload identity federation, and automate detection and remediation of configuration drift.</li> <li>Help establish equivalent security patterns in AWS and Azure.</li> </ul> <h3>Protect AI agents and MCP services</h3> <ul> <li>Help design and evolve secure patterns for MCP hosts, clients, servers, gateways and registries.</li> <li>Build or operate MCP gateways and registries with approved-tool allowlisting, tool-level authorisation, rate limits and auditable records of tool calls.</li> <li>Implement OAuth 2.1/OIDC authorisation using short-lived, scoped and audience-bound tokens; avoid token passthrough and require human approval for high-impact actions.</li> <li>Help secure MCP services hosted on Cloud Run or GKE, using controls such as Identity-Aware Proxy and prompt or response screening.</li> <li>Threat-model and help defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, unauthorised tool changes, confused-deputy attacks and data exfiltration through chained tool calls.</li> <li>Help secure the agent and connector supply chain through vetting, signing, versioning, scanning and sandboxing.</li> </ul> <h3>Engineer identity and access controls</h3> <ul> <li>Implement identity patterns for people, workloads and agents across Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, including federation, SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access and phishing-resistant MFA.</li> <li>Extend identity governance to service accounts, API keys, workload identities and AI agents, using Saviynt or a comparable identity governance platform.</li> <li>Support clear ownership, lifecycle management and regular access reviews for non-human identities.</li> <li>Apply zero-standing-privilege principles through just-in-time elevation, short-lived credentials and automated access revocation.</li> <li>Assess emerging capabilities such as Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Okta Cross App Access.</li> </ul> <h3>Protect data and enable secure sharing</h3> <ul> <li>Build data transformation pipelines and governed data products using dbt, SQL and Terraform.</li> <li>Apply controls such as data classification, lineage, model contracts, policy tags, masking, row-level security and least-privilege access.</li> <li>Help deliver data securely to clients and partners through BigQuery Analytics Hub, cross-cloud storage transfers and API integrations.</li> <li>Support secure ingestion, cleansing, enrichment and transformation, with scoped access, encryption, audit logging and monitoring at each hand-off.</li> <li>Develop secure data-sharing patterns, including data clean rooms and consent-aware pipelines.</li> <li>Help prevent sensitive data from leaking into agent prompts, context windows, logs or third-party models, and ensure agents access curated data rather than unrestricted raw tables.</li> </ul> <h3>Secure social and marketing platforms</h3> <ul> <li>Bring brand social accounts, advertising platforms and martech tools under central identity control using Cerby or a comparable solution.</li> <li>Support secure onboarding and offboarding, credential rotation, enforced MFA and time-limited, auditable access for agencies, freelancers and creators.</li> <li>Treat social content—including comments, direct messages, reviews and mentions—as untrusted input.</li> <li>Design guardrails so agents cannot combine access to private data, untrusted content and the ability to publish externally without appropriate safeguards.</li> <li>Work with Marketing and Communications teams to detect and respond to account takeovers, impersonation and advertising-account fraud.</li> </ul> <h3>Improve detection, response and secure delivery</h3> <ul> <li>Send cloud, identity, MCP, model-safety and social-platform logs to the SIEM.</li> <li>Build detections as code and develop SOAR playbooks that can revoke tokens, disable agents, quarantine MCP servers and rotate credentials, with human approval for high-impact actions.</li> <li>Create golden paths, reference implementations and runbooks that help delivery teams build securely and independently.</li> <li>Contribute to threat-modelling sessions, red-team exercises, design reviews and audit-readiness activities.</li> <li>Help map controls to relevant standards and automate evidence collection.</li> <li>Share knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <h3>Experience and technical skills</h3> <ul> <li>Seasoned<strong> experience</strong> in cloud infrastructure, platform, data or security engineering, including <strong>hands-on GCP experience in production</strong>.</li> <li>Strong practical GCP skills, such as IAM, organisation policies, networking, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Run or GKE, and BigQuery.</li> <li>Working knowledge of comparable security capabilities in AWS and Azure.</li> <li>Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, environment and state management, testing, CI/CD and policy-as-code.</li> <li>Experience engineering identity controls with Microsoft Entra ID and/or Okta, including SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access, MFA and privileged or just-in-time access. Familiarity with Saviynt or another IGA platform is expected.</li> <li>Hands-on SIEM and SOAR experience, including onboarding log sources, developing detections and building response playbooks.</li> <li>Practical understanding of MCP and agent security. This could come from production work, open-source contributions or well-developed proofs of concept.</li> <li>Experience with dbt and SQL for data transformation or data products, and a working understanding of data-layer controls such as classification, masking, row-level security and access grants.</li> <li>Experience delivering data to clients or partners across organisational or cloud boundaries, using services such as BigQuery Analytics Hub, GCS, S3, Azure Blob Storage or APIs.</li> <li>Coding ability in Python, Go or TypeScript for automation, tooling or MCP server development.</li> <li>Familiarity with social, advertising or marketing platforms and the security challenges involved in managing brand accounts and non-SSO applications.</li> </ul> <h3>How you work</h3> <ul> <li>You build securely by default and consider how systems could be misused from the outset.</li> <li>You automate repeatable work, test what you codify and look for ways to make secure delivery easier.</li> <li>You balance risk, usability and delivery needs, and can explain when a solution is not ready—and what would make it safe to proceed.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues and can explain security risks in plain language.</li> <li>You document decisions and create practical standards, golden paths and runbooks.</li> <li>You measure outcomes, learn from incidents and feedback, and improve controls over time.</li> <li>You collaborate inclusively, seek different perspectives and support the development of colleagues.</li> </ul> <h3>Security and regulatory frameworks</h3> <p>You’ll be familiar with relevant security, privacy and AI frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, CIS Benchmarks, UK GDPR/GDPR and the EU AI Act.</p> <h2>Certifications</h2> <p>You should hold—or be willing to achieve after joining:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect</strong> within six months.</li> <li><strong>Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer</strong> within 12 months.</li> </ul> <p>WPP will fund exam fees and provide dedicated study time.</p> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience operating MCP servers or gateways in production, or contributing to open-source agent or security tooling.</li> <li>Google Security Operations or Microsoft Sentinel title: Manager, Analytics, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3263 - Manager, Analytics, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><strong>ABOUT OPENDOOR & MGM</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we're constantly reinventing the future of creativity, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and expertise across communications, media, experience, commerce, technology and entertainment marketing.</p> <p>That philosophy sits at the heart of OpenDoor's partnership with MGM, Amazon's iconic film studio. For more than a century, MGM has shaped some of the world's most recognised stories, franchises and cinematic moments. Today, as part of Amazon, it combines Hollywood legacy with the scale, innovation and customer obsession of one of the world's most influential entertainment companies.</p> <p>MGM's future slate reflects this unique position, bringing audiences a diverse portfolio of theatrical releases and cultural moments. Upcoming titles such as Verity, The Thomas Crown Affair, The Sheep Detective, Masters of the Universe, and The Beekeeper 2 show the breadth of MGM's ambitions across adaptations, franchises, action blockbusters and original storytelling.</p> <p>OpenDoor was built to help MGM maximise the impact of these moments. By combining WPP's talent, capabilities and technology, we create integrated solutions that connect media, creative, data, strategy, commerce and measurement into a seamless operating model. Our role extends beyond campaign execution to helping MGM understand audiences, optimise investment, measure business impact and build long-term cultural relevance.</p> <p>The OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next-level productivity through our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms and Process. Drawing expertise from across WPP agencies and disciplines, our teams work closely with MGM stakeholders to unlock smarter, faster and more effective ways of bringing stories to audiences worldwide.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, you become part of a team operating at the intersection of entertainment, technology, media and creativity. You'll work alongside leading industry talent while supporting one of the world's most exciting film studios as it enters its next chapter, helping shape how audiences discover and engage with stories that define culture.</p> <p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></p> <p>We are searching for an analytically ambitious, detail-oriented analytics specialist with a genuine passion for film and entertainment to join our OpenDoor team as Manager, Trailer & Campaign Analytics – MGM. This role reports into the Global Director of Insights for MGM and is based in London.</p> <p>This is a high-impact individual contributor role focused on building and scaling the analytics infrastructure for trailer performance and in-flight campaign measurement across MGM's theatrical release slate and global marketing operations. You will own the end-to-end setup and delivery of automated trailer reporting systems, working with the team to establish benchmarks, build learnings, and continuously optimize campaign performance through data-driven insights.</p> <p>What makes this role distinctive is the opportunity to build measurement discipline from the ground up for two critical areas: pre-launch trailer analytics and real-time in-flight campaign monitoring. You'll inherit foundational frameworks and collaborate with the broader Measurement team to enhance these with attention measurement, creative A/B testing, and social listening capabilities. You're expected to identify opportunities for automation and agent-assisted reporting that will scale insights over time — contributing directly to the efficiency and impact of MGM's global theatrical marketing operation.</p> <p>This role operates at the intersection of Paid Media measurement, Cultural Impact analytics, Creative Performance, and multi-platform reporting — translating performance data into clear, actionable insights that directly inform investment and optimization decisions across MGM's theatrical release calendar. The scope is global with particular focus on key markets, informing measurement practice and learning agendas that shape how MGM launches its most ambitious stories.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <p>Establish & Run Trailer Analytics Reporting</p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operationalize automated trailer performance reporting across all format variants (teaser, full trailer, format cuts) and distribution platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, Pinterest, etc.)</li> <li>Establish standardized reporting cadence: 24-hour, 72-hour, and 7-day performance snapshots for all trailer launches across key territories and global markets</li> <li>Define and build trailer-level KPI frameworks (view velocity, engagement rates, audience retention, CPA, brand lift signals) and communicate performance against pre-established benchmarks</li> <li>Integrate territory-level performance data to identify which markets are responding strongest to creative approaches, messaging, and format variants</li> <li>Support the development of automated reporting pipelines and dashboards that enable stakeholders to self-serve key insights between formal reports</li> </ul> <p>Integrate Social Listening & Cultural Impact Measurement</p> <ul> <li>Deploy social listening tools (Brandwatch, Talkwalker, or equivalent) to track organic conversation, sentiment, and cultural momentum around trailer launches</li> <li>Combine organic social signals with paid media performance to build a holistic view of trailer impact across both title: Director, Data Science and Solutions, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3753 - Director, Data Science and Solutions, UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong> </p> <p><strong>Practice Overview</strong> </p> <p>WPP Media Data, Tech & Analytics is WPP’s data, analytics, and technology services division. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by leveraging the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.  </p> <p>Our team works with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through analytically minded people leveraging AI and tech to drive real business change for our clients. We’re endlessly curious. Our team of analytical thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world. Within our UK Data, Tech and Analytics team we host three core practices – Modelling Services, Applied Analytics and Data Science and Solutions. </p> <p>The Data Science & Solutions practice is the innovation engine and technical accelerator for WPP Media Data, Tech & Analytics Division in the UK. We bridge advanced data science, artificial intelligence, and software engineering to solve high-value client challenges and supercharge agency capabilities. The practice operates at the intersection of technical innovation and commercial media application—incubating proprietary analytical tools, advancing AI adoption, and delivering specialised machine learning models that go beyond traditional econometrics. We strive to be the benchmark for intelligent, ethical and commercially transformative decisioning through applied data science.</p> <p><strong>Team Summary and Remit</strong> </p> <p>Sitting alongside Modelling Services and Applied Analytics within our 120-strong UK Analytics organisation, the Data Science & Solutions team has two core mandates: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Advanced Tool & Solution Development:</strong> Designing, engineering, and productising bespoke analytical applications, automation pipelines, and AI-enabled tools that elevate the speed, sophistication, and efficiency of our wider Modelling and Applied Analytics teams. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong><em>Specialised Modelling & Advanced Analytics (Role Focus):</em></strong><em> Delivering high-impact data science assignments requiring techniques beyond the core scope of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), such as customer lifetime value (CLV), propensity and churn modelling, advanced incrementality algorithms, and price elasticity.</em> </li> </ul> <p>This Director role will focus on the second of the two above – Specialised Modelling and Advanced Analytics, helping to enhance the implementation of our internal solutions related to this. Our other director's remit sits in the first area of mandates. There is of course collaboration – but we are looking for someone to bring expertise in the second mandate of the team. </p> <p>These mandates are delivered in line with our principles – <strong>Value, Scale and Innovation</strong>. Turning complex data signals into undeniable business growth for our clients. Being trusted co-pilots who make solutions scalable, interpretable and actionable. Working in a high trust, high impact environment where innovation yields measurable consequence. </p> <p><strong>Summary of Role Responsibilities</strong> </p> <p>As Director, Data Science and Solutions, UK, your core mandate is to <strong>Execute Strategy at Scale - specifically driving our implementation of Advanced Analytics Data Science solutions across the UK</strong>. You will translate practice strategy set by the VP and functional leadership into measurable operational outcomes and delivery excellence across significant client portfolios. You are accountable for overseeing programme delivery, driving operational optimisation, and managing team structures that deliver robust, production-grade analytics. </p> <p>Strategic Execution & Technical Leadership </p> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Planning: </strong>Translate practice strategy and data science roadmaps into actionable, short-to-mid-term operational plans (<1 year) across client accounts. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Excellence: </strong>Enforce technical excellence and operational standards across all client deliverables, including causal impact analysis, Bayesian econometrics, predictive propensity modelling, and geospatial segmentation. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering & Governance: </strong>Champion rigorous engineering and governance practices across the team: clean code, GitHub project management, reproducibility, data privacy, and ethical AI compliance. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Media Strategy Integration: </strong>Bridge advanced data science capability with client-facing media strategy, directly demonstrating how predictive modelling optimizes planning, budget allocation, and activation. </li> </ul> <p>Programme Delivery & Client Integration </p> <ul> <li><strong>Complex Programme Delivery: </strong>Direct and oversee large, complex client delivery workstreams, ensuring solutions are robust, delivered within scope and timeline, and embedded directly into media activation workflows and WPP Open tools. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Senior Client Partnership: </strong>Act as a trusted technical and strategic partner for senior client stakeholders (Heads of Analytics, Marketing Directors, Performance Leads), interpreting complex data science outputs into clear commercial recommendations. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Integration: </strong>Partner with Agency Planning, Client Leadership, and Data Strategy teams to embed advanced data science solutions (e.g., headroom analysis, automated audience generation) into day-to-day media operations. </li> </ul> <p>People & Operational Management </p> <ul> <li><strong>People Leadership & Development: </strong>Line manage and mentor Associate Directors and Managers, fostering technical growth, high-performance delivery, and structured career progression. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Resource & Capacity Management: </strong>Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and billable utilization across your assigned portfolio, identifying staffing requirements and technical capability gaps. </li> <li><strong>Commercial & Cost Governance: </strong>Partner with the VP to monitor project scopes, manage cloud computing/infrastructure costs, and support accurate revenue forecasting. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience </strong></p> <p>Must Have</p> <ul> <li><strong>Marketing, Media Planning & Activation Cycle:</strong> Understanding across the modern media cycle, demonstrating how data science models directly inform insight generation, audience discovery, cross-channel budget optimization, and live activation. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Operational & Programme Leadership:</strong> Proven track record managing multi-disciplinary delivery teams and leading managers/specialists within a media agency, management consultancy, or tech-enabled enterprise. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Mastery:</strong> Comprehensive hands-on and architectural understanding of statistical modelling, audience propensity models, inference, regression/econometric frameworks, classification/clustering algorithms, and ML pipelines (Python, SQL, Git). </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Stakeholder Translation:</strong> Demonstrated ability to communicate highly sophisticated mathematical and technical concepts clearly to non-technical executive stakeholders and commercial partners. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery Governance:</strong> Experience managing project scope, milestones, cloud infrastructure expenditure, and cross-functional project teams. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Typically requires a University Degree (STEM or quantitative field preferred) or equivalent experience, with 10+ years of progressive professional and technical leadership experience. </li> </ul> <p>Nice to Haves </p> <ul> <li>Experience operationalizing data products or custom algorithms within cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure). </li> <li>Familiarity with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, and modern data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbs

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3726 - Associate Director, Data, Tech & Analytics, Global Client Solutions</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><strong>ABOUT WPP & OPENDOOR</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built <strong>OpenDoor </strong>for<strong> Amazon</strong>.</p> <p><strong>OpenDoor</strong> is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive <em>impact</em> – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own <a href="https://www.amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles"><strong>16 Leadership Principles</strong></a>, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Data Governance Director. This is a full-time, senior leadership position. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best-in-class service for Amazon in every country across its MGM and CDS business lines.</p> <p>In this role will act as the key operational bridge across internal WPP teams, client leadership, local market contacts, offshore delivery teams, external creative agencies, and third-party partners. By establishing robust workflows, owning platform integrations, and managing data governance compliance, you will ensure campaigns are executed accurately, on time, and in strict alignment with global standards.</p> <p>As a Data Excellence Associate Director, you will be a strategic leader, focused on taxonomy compliance and responsible for championing a customer-centric data excellence strategy, fostering strong relationships with senior stakeholders, and significantly investing in the growth and development of the Data Governance team. You will drive adoption of data quality standards, ensuring OpenDoor's data assets provide maximum business impact for Amazon. </p> <p>RESPONSIBILITIES</p> <p><strong>Operational Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Account Operations:</strong> Partner closely with Activation and Client Leadership to ensure the day-to-day operations of the line of business run seamlessly. Collaborate with relevant eternal stakeholders (e.g. DoubleVerify) to ensure accurate account configuration and tracking integrity, while coordinating team training sessions for newly released features.</li> <li><strong>Process Documentation:</strong> Design, implement, and brief teams on essential operational infrastructure, including live/pre-live status documents, proof of posting (PoP) trackers, Wrike workflows, workback schedules, and other tracking templates.</li> <li><strong>GOC Management:</strong> Ensure clear delegation and structured briefings to remotely based Global Operations Centre ad ops teams delivery teams to guarantee flawless campaign tracking and execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Campaign Trafficking & Stakeholder Coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Trafficking Execution Support:</strong> Partner with activation and GOC delivery teams to ensure campaigns are accurately trafficked, tags are correctly implemented, and delivery issues are resolved rapidly.</li> <li><strong>Partner & Local Market Alignment:</strong> Act as an operational bridge between DoubleVerify and local market teams during onboarding to align platform setups with upcoming advertising activity.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with Activation, Client Leadership, and platform teams on daily operational workflows and feature training.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Taxonomy, Governance & PBR Compliance</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>PBR Score Ownership:</strong> Take full accountability for meeting and exceeding the target delivery documents, and briefing templates prior to offloading to offshore execution teams to guarantee taxonomy compliance at setup.</li> <li><strong>Training & Enablement:</strong> Schedule, design, and facilitate regular "Taxonomy & Workflow" refresher sessions throughout the year to keep the team aligned on platforms, processes, and requirements.</li> <li><strong>Issue Resolution:</strong> Act title: Lead Account Executive, Enterprise UK&I
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Lead at the forefront of AI & Data Resilience</em></strong></p> <p>At Veeam, we don’t just talk about the future of technology — we are actively shaping it. We are a global leader in data resilience, operating at the epicentre of the AI, cloud and security evolution. Our culture is built by forward-thinking technologists with heart: people who challenge convention, collaborate openly, and believe that great ideas can come from anywhere.</p> <p>Joining Veeam means being part of a business that combines the energy and agility of a start-up with the scale, credibility, and market leadership of a global technology powerhouse. We focus relentlessly on customer outcomes, empower our teams to own their destiny, and create an inclusive environment where every voice matters.</p> <p><strong><em>Why Veeam</em></strong></p> <p>Work at the heart of AI-driven data resilience, enjoy flexibility and outcome-based performance, and lead with autonomy in a globally recognized organization that invests deeply in its people, culture, and leadership.</p> <p><strong><em>The Opportunity</em></strong></p> <p>This is a pivotal growth role within Veeam’s UK & Ireland organization.</p> <p>As Lead Account Executive, Enterprise you will be responsible for a book of existing key FTSE 100 & 250 customers and a set of target enterprise accounts to hunt and close net new logo acquisition. You will drive a daily rhythm to ensure in quarter execution and build forward pipeline. You will develop a clear point of view on the market and a constant curiosity to link corporate objectives and technology initiatives with customer and partners alike. You will set and manage the strategy for your Territory working with specialist teams in the UK & Ireland and Inside Sales and Sales Development teams based in Bucharest.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director of Enterprise, UK & Ireland, you will play a central role in shaping how Veeam engages customers, partners, and the market — accelerating growth while building a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the vision for your UK & Ireland Enterprise Territory</li> <li>Coordinate virtual, geographically distributed teams</li> <li>Drive disciplined sales execution across the full Veeam portfolio</li> <li>Accelerate growth in hybrid cloud and cloud-native environments</li> <li>Build executive-level relationships with senior stakeholders</li> <li>Challenge the status quo with bold, innovative ideas</li> <li>Partner with Channel, Hyperscalers, and System Integrators</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>What Success Looks Like</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Sustained revenue growth and increased wallet share</li> <li>Strong operational excellence and predictable execution</li> <li>High-trust, high-performance sales culture</li> <li>Deep, long-term customer and partner relationships</li> <li>A future-ready, scalable Enterprise Territory</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <p>You are a seasoned Enterprise Sales Account Manager with presence, energy, and ambition. You bring a proven track record of leading go-to-market strategy and execution in complex technology environments, deep understanding of data resilience and cloud ecosystems, and an inspirational style to coordinate and excite virtual teams.</p> <p><strong><em>Experience & Qualifications</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in business or technical discipline (or equivalent experience)</li> title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. Overview of the Role You will build the Site Reliability Engineering function at Zego, embedding reliability, observability and operational excellence as core engineering concerns - AI is the primary lever for doing that at scale, not a bolt on. You will be our dedicated SRE, working alongside Systems Engineering and embedded with Product and Engineering across roughly 120 engineers. Teams own their services and their own on-call. You own the framework, the instrumentation and the AI tooling that makes that ownership work. You will make teams good at running what they build: alert quality over alert volume, runbooks an agent can execute rather than prose that describes, and diagnostics good enough that an engineer or an agent reaches resolution without an SRE in the room. You will be the primary advocate for reliability with Product and Engineering, making the case with data rather than assertion, so platform health is prioritised alongside delivery commitments. Key Responsibilities Define and land the reliability standard: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and production readiness criteria that teams apply to their own services, with adoption measured rather than assumed. Encode standards into automation rather than enforcing them by hand. Guardrails in CI, agents that check reliability and observability posture on pull requests, and safe defaults in shared infrastructure so the reliable path is the easy path. Build SRE capability on Zego's AI platform, extending our MCP servers and agents, and making the estate legible to them through machine readable runbooks, structured telemetry and diagnostics an agent can act on. Own observability as a practice, including instrumentation design, signal quality, cardinality and cost. Raise the standard of incident response end-to-end, from detection and triage through to retrospectives that produce change. Put AI to work where it pays off most, stripping toil out of incidents so responders can focus on judgement Measure toil, publish it, and remove it through tooling that others can run without you. What you will need to be successful in the Role We are looking for an engineer who lives SRE and DevOps culture, and treats AI tooling as a default part of how the work gets done, not a side experiment. You will engage and empower teams through decisions grounded in data, and you will be as comfortable building with AI as consuming it: extending MCP servers, writing agents, and automating the operational work that would otherwise fill your week. We treat reliability at Zego as a platform capability, so we care more about what you can make repeatable for others than what you can fix yourself. What you’ll bring to the Team Deep SRE experience: SLI and SLO definition, error budget management, and ownership of incident response through to blameless retrospectives. Fluency with AI as an engineering tool rather than a chat window: building agents and automation, working with MCP servers or equivalent, and judgement about where an agent can act and where a human stays in the loop. Strong software engineering in Python, writing tested, maintainable code that other engineers can run and extend. Observability depth with OpenTelemetry and Datadog. AWS at scale, and Kubernetes based platforms managed through Infrastructure as Code. Desirable Istio, Crossplane and ArgoCD. We run all three and will teach the specifics to the right person. Running ML or AI workloads in production, such as model serving or feature pipelines. We do this at Zego and you would help support it. Having been a sole delivery owner somewhere, and knowing what that does and does not mean. The Zego ways of working 🏡 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it. We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. description: If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place. As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale. We do this in two ways: Goodstack for Business helps some of the world's leading companies power their social impact programmes. Goodstack for Causes helps nonprofits access the funding, technology and resources they need to thrive. And we're already making a difference: $11 billion in donations facilitated since 2022. Over 13 million mission-driven organisations in the world's largest verified database. 500,000+ nonprofits on our platform, with thousands more joining every week. Trusted by global companies including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Open AI, Canva, TikTok and Airbnb , alongside nonprofits such as the Red Cross, Cancer Research UK and Oxfam . What We're Building Next 🚀 We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide. By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently. Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems. That's where you come in 🫵 Join us as Head of IT & Security to help our teams support nonprofits with confidence! We’re looking for a practical, technically credible Head of IT & Security to own and improve the systems, services and controls that help Goodstack work effectively and securely. You’ll set the direction, make decisions and deliver changes, leading a small, hands-on team. From improving how colleagues get equipment and access to leading our information-security programme, you’ll connect the details to the wider business and make clear trade-offs around risk, productivity, cost and culture. If you enjoy building a function, developing others and taking improvements from an idea through to a working result, this is an opportunity to shape IT and security in a business helping nonprofits access technology and funding. Working with the VP of Architecture & Infrastructure, you’ll develop the function’s capabilities as Goodstack grows. As Head of IT and Security, your mission will be to: Own IT and security strategy and delivery. Assess our environment, set priorities and deliver improvements alongside your team. Balance security, productivity, cost and culture while meeting customer commitments. Own the roadmap, budget and risk register, making pragmatic decisions, explaining trade-offs and escalating material risks with recommendations. Build IT that scales with Goodstack . Own identity, devices, SaaS, office technology and employee lifecycle processes. Work with People, Finance, Operations and managers to improve the complete employee experience, remove cross-team friction and reduce manual effort without weakening controls. Lead and develop the function . Set direction, coach technical judgement and support complex work while remaining hands-on. Ensure reliable support coverage and protect time for improvements. Anticipate capability gaps and recommend training, tooling, specialist support or hiring. Own security, compliance and assurance. Lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2, ensuring policies, controls, audits and evidence are maintained year-round. Work with Engineering on application and cloud risks, including XSS, access controls and configuration weaknesses, ensuring remediation is prioritised and verified. Find weaknesses before they cause harm. Challenge assumptions through threat modelling, authorised security testing, incident exercises and recovery tests. Turn findings into preventive improvements, verify their effectiveness and coordinate security incidents when needed. Build a culture of secure working. Make secure behaviour the easiest choice. Understand why shortcuts happen, improve processes and incentives, provide practical training and encourage early reporting. Help colleagues navigate decisions where the right answer isn't obvious. Own vendors and security relationships. Manage suppliers, licences, renewals, service quality, spend and continuity plans. Coordinate vendor risk, contractual security requirements, subprocessors and privacy operations with Legal, the DPO and business owners. Represent Goodstack in customer security reviews and with auditors and assessors. Lead AI governance and enablement. Own our ISO/IEC 42001 programme, coordinating risk assessments, controls, audit readiness and responsible AI requirements across teams. Establish safeguards for data, access, evaluation and human oversight. Help colleagues adopt approved AI tools safely through guidance, training and pilots, measuring proficiency and impact while department leaders own adoption outcomes. Make IT smarter through automation. Identify recurring problems, employee time lost and avoidable manual work. Choose between simplifying processes, existing tools, deterministic workflows and AI based on risk, value and maintenance cost. Design and review complex automations, measure improvements and ensure appropriate testing, monitoring, exception handling and human oversight. Build a function that doesn't depend on individuals. Establish clear ownership, documentation, recovery procedures and organisation-managed credentials. Ensure critical workflows survive staff departures and can be maintained by others. Use service metrics and operational feedback to continually improve priorities. After 3, 6 and 9 months, success will look like: 3 months: You've assessed the environment, agreed a prioritised roadmap and delivered initial improvements. Key risks, controls, audit commitments and findings have clear owners. Service baselines are established, and the scope and gaps for ISO/IEC 42001 are understood. 6 months: Routine IT runs reliably without your daily involvement. Measurable improvements show reduced manual effort, delays, and errors without weakening controls. Critical automations have tested recovery arrangements, and initial AI enablement work demonstrates progress. Evidence informs what to continue, simplify, or stop. 9 months: Improvements are sustained, recurring problems are addressed at their source, and leadership has a clear view of risk, spend and priorities. Security exercises and feedback drive prevention, critical workflows can be maintained by others, and you're independently shaping the function's next stage. Strong knowledge of identity, devices, SaaS and workplace IT, alongside enough application and cloud security expertise to challenge and collaborate with engineers. Led ISO 27001 or SOC 2 through assessment and ongoing operation, with the ability to manage both. Excellent judgement balancing security, usability, cost and business needs, including identifying root causes and making decisions under uncertainty. Experience leading and developing colleagues while remaining technically hands-on. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence behaviour, resolve ambiguity and build practical working relationships. Experience delivering reliable automation using scripts, workflows or AI, with sound judgement on security, testing, failure handling, maintainability and measurable impact. title: Senior Data Engineer
description: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. About the role Abound is changing the face of lending. Our data lake will change the pace and the way we operate. It will power most of the decisions we make, from credit and pricing to operations and finance, and it is the foundation of our AI future. None of that works without data people can trust. Our data is our most valuable asset, and this role is its custodian. As our Senior Data Engineer, you will own the warehouse that turns raw data from underwriting, lending, open banking and finance into the facts the whole company runs on. You will help shape that future. Through a semantic layer and natural-language-to-SQL tools, anyone at Abound will be able to ask a question in plain English and get a correct answer in seconds. You decide how the model is built, what it measures, and how AI uses it. You will not start from a blank page. The first version of the warehouse is live, with real users and real problems to solve. This is an engineering role, not a SQL-only ETL job: you will write production Python and Spark, and work side by side with data science. Responsibilities Make the semantic layer and natural-language-to-SQL tools the way teams answer everyday questions. Define each metric with its business owner, and test that the tools return the agreed number. Own the warehouse design and modelling standards, and approve every change to it. Work with data scientists to turn their use cases into tested facts, dimensions and marts. Move features from the application backend, and reports from QuickSight, onto the lake, and prove they match the originals. Run and tune the Spark pipeline that feeds the warehouse, and fix performance bottlenecks in Spark and Athena. Own data quality, reconciliation and PII handling, and keep Glue and Athena costs in check. Mentor the engineers and analysts who contribute to the warehouse. What we're looking for You have owned a production warehouse before, and you can point to a dimensional model you designed and the decisions behind it. You write Python and Spark as confidently as SQL. 5+ years in data engineering, with at least 2 owning the design of a production warehouse or lakehouse. Proven dimensional modelling: conformed dimensions, fact grain, SCD2, and late-arriving or restated data. You can explain the trade-offs you made. Experience making data usable by AI: a semantic layer such as MetricFlow, Cube or LookML, natural-language-to-SQL or LLM agents over governed data, and checking that their answers are right. Strong dbt in production: incremental models, macros, tests and CI. Collaborating with support, infrastructure and other teams to turn customer needs into shipped features. title: Member of Technical Staff, Intelligence
description: LOCATION: King’s Cross, London · PATTERN: Hybrid, with regular time in the lab The opportunity We’re a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You’d help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role builds our analysis from the start. Every result leaves an instrument as a trace or a vendor file, and it has to become a value someone can rely on, linked back to the sequence and sample it came from. That means fitting it properly, checking it against controls, catching the plate or reagent lot that drifted, and showing the evidence. Someone has to own that work. That is this role. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. We’ll share more about what we’re building once you’ve spoken with the team. The role You will join the intelligence team and own the analysis of our assay data, and the data and ML infrastructure it runs on, from the point the data has been captured to the result that gets delivered. You will work most closely with the protein characterisation scientists who run the assays, and with the software team, who get data out of the instruments and own the platform it lives on. You build on top of that platform, and you own the quality of the analysis that runs on it. The role is part data engineer and part biostatistician, and all of the data is biological. Much of it is building the analysis and ML pipelines that run on our captured data, and the statistics inside them. The rest is presenting those results clearly, with the statistics that matter, such as uncertainty and QC, shown in a form they can understand. The value is in doing that carefully, in code that behaves the same way on every run. What you will own ● Analysis and ML pipelines that turn captured assay and sequence data into consistent, versioned datasets, linked to the sequence, sample, plate and well each result came from, built with the software team who own data capture. ● Data validation before any analysis runs, catching a mislabelled plate, a swapped sample or a missing well. ● Sequence-level bioinformatics, such as computing the properties of each protein sequence and checking constructs for problems before the DNA is ordered. ● Biostatistics for experimental data: experimental design, replicates and controls, error propagation, outlier handling, and assay acceptance criteria, such as CV across replicates, Z′ for plate assays, and reference standards staying within range. ● Curve fitting, including dose-response (EC50 and IC50) with sound normalisation and fits to SPR, BLI, HPLC and nanoDSF traces, with a measure of confidence on each fitted parameter and automated QC that sends doubtful fits to a person. ● Detection of plate, lot and batch effects across a dataset before it is delivered, and control charting of reference standards so drift shows up over weeks as well as within a run. ● The data visualisation that accompanies each delivered result, showing it with its uncertainty, QC and batch structure, so anyone can understand and check it without asking us. Who you are You have worked with messy experimental data and built things other people relied on. That might have been in a biotech or pharma team, an academic lab, a core facility, or a data-heavy field outside biology where you have since picked up the biology. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you. You are happy to get your hands dirty on the data. Much of the job is careful, repeated work on real instrument output, and we want someone who takes pride in doing that well. You write code other people can run, and you care how a result reads to the person receiving it. Seniority is not what we are screening for. We are open to someone early in their career and to someone with many years behind them. What we look for is depth and judgement on experimental data. We do not hire people into boxes. This role will stretch past its description, sometimes into the lab and sometimes into conversations beyond the team. Early hires here are expected to pick up what is in front of them. Must have ● Building and running production data and ML pipelines, ideally on scientific or lab data, including data modelling, validation and reproducible, versioned workflows. ● Handling the specifics of biological data: plate layouts, sample and reagent lot lineage, and protein and DNA construct sequences with the standard tools for working with them. ● Biostatistics for experimental data, including experimental design, replicates and controls, curve fitting, and separating batch effects from biology. ● Statistical process control and anomaly detection, so assay drift and instrument variability are caught early. ● Data visualisation for people outside your team, presenting results with their uncertainty and QC so they can understand and check them themselves. ● Fluency in Python and its scientific stack, including pandas, NumPy and SciPy, and in working with coding agents. ● SQL and relational schema design for samples, plates and results. ● Turning scientists’ questions into requirements, and writing down the assumptions behind them. Nice to have ● Hands-on analysis of instrument output from a lab, especially trace-based data such as SPR or HPLC. ● R for statistical modelling, such as dose-response fitting or mixed models for plate and batch effects. ● Containers and cloud infrastructure, such as Docker, Kubernetes and AWS. ● Working with data from LIMS, electronic lab notebooks or lab data standards. ● Current protein language models and structure prediction, such as ESM C, Boltz-2, Chai, OpenFold3 or AlphaFold 3. Why this is unusual Most assay data analysis happens far from the lab, on files someone exported weeks earlier, with little record of how the experiment ran. Here you sit next to the lab, the conditions of every run are recorded, and your analysis is delivered alongside the data. The work also changes under you. The lab starts with people running the instruments and becomes automated over time, and the analysis you first build by hand becomes the checks that run on every result. Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. It’s worth knowing in advance which one you are. How we work The role is based in London, at our lab and office in King’s Cross. Time in person with the scientists matters for this work. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building. We work in the open. Decisions are written down and work happens in Slack. The whole company meets once a week at the start of the week, and there is a regular offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late. UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows. The team you will join You will report to the intelligence lead. You will also work closely with the founders and with the protein characterisation scientists whose data you will analyse. We are a small, elite team, weighted towards science and software. You will be the first person on the intelligence team whose focus is the analysis and ML infrastructure behind our results. Our process Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work and what you value, run from the same template for every candidate. A technical stage built on a real analysis problem from our lab, not a puzzle. You spend a few hours writing up how you would approach it, using the tools you would use on the job, coding agents included, with a short note on the decisions you made. We care about judgement more than hours, so a focused answer beats an exhaustive one. We then go through it with you in person. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand. If you are not sure whether you are a fit, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide. We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM</li> <li>Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O</li> <li>Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover</li> <li>Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up.</li> <li>Fluent English for work in international teams</li> <li>Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s</li> <li>Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics</li> <li>A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have:<strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents</li> <li>Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. </p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>. </p> </div> </section> </div> </div> </section> </div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Designer - London
description: As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations. At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them. What you'll be doing Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them. Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction. Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship. Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn. Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike. Who you'll work with The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback. Likely a good fit if you Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies. Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive. Have a portfolio that shows your latest work. Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests. Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new. Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control. Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers. Are fluent in Figma. Can work within a design system and contribute to it. Stronger still if you Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces. Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us. If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match. How we hire Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our London office, and a closing 30-minute conversation. The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.
