title: Engineering Lead (Drivers & Delivery)
description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures , Maersk Growth , Pale Blue Dot VC , Eka Ventures , NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 We're looking for an Engineering Lead to head up HIVED's Driver Squad: the team that owns everything between a parcel leaving our depot and arriving at the customer's door. Every delivery comes down to two things: the driver, and the tools they work with. The squad owns both. We build the strongest possible driver population, identifying our best drivers, making performance transparent and helping our operations teams reward and retain them. And we build the tools drivers and operators rely on: the driver app, Mission Control (our operator dashboard), and the telemetry that shows us what really happens on the road. You'll lead a team of engineers, shape the squad's technical strategy together with its Product Manager, and work closely with our operations teams. Your team's work moves the numbers that matter most for HIVED: delivery cost per parcel, delivery success and customer satisfaction. The problems are concrete and varied. How do we know which drivers are our best, and how do we make performance transparent enough to act on? How do we reliably collect high-fidelity telemetry from a mobile app on the road, at scale? Where is the best place to park to deliver a given street, and how do we learn that from data? And what do operators need to see in Mission Control, and when, to keep a live operation running smoothly? What You'll Be Doing 🚀 Shape and champion the technical strategy. Decide, together with the Product Manager and in close collaboration with operations, which technologies and tech products we bring to the domain, and translate squad goals into clear technical direction. Organise effective delivery. Own how the team plans, prioritises and ships, with a focus on meaningful business outcomes rather than technical output. Build a high-performing team. Hire, coach and manage engineers, and establish and maintaining a high bar for performance. Guide the architecture. Facilitate and champion the team's architecture vision across distributed backend systems, data pipelines, mobile and web. Stay hands-on. Take part in design discussions, code reviews and technical problem-solving, and contribute directly where it adds the most value. Stay close to the operation. Work with drivers and operations teams, see how our tools perform on the ground, and close the loop with data. What We're Looking For 🔎 Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, building and operating production systems. Experience building and managing a high-performing engineering team, including hiring and performance management. Strong system design skills in distributed, production-grade environments, including event-driven architectures and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred). Experience building products on top of those systems, such as user-facing apps, internal tools or data products, and caring about how people actually use them. A track record of shaping technical strategy for a domain, and of facilitating architecture decisions within a team. The ability to translate ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact. Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, product, data and operations. Nice to Have ✨ Experience in logistics, mobility, fleet or workforce management, or marketplaces. Experience with telemetry, geospatial or high-volume event data. Experience with mobile apps for frontline workers, ideally React Native. Experience in a fast-scaling operational environment where software has a direct physical-world impact. Technologies We Use 💻 Python, Go, TypeScript React Native (driver app), React (Mission Control) AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript) GCP, BigQuery, Looker Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus GitHub, GitHub Actions Claude Code Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design Our interviewing process 🪜 Intro call with the hiring manager Live coding challenge solving a problem A take home case study, followed by a discussion On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture) Our Values 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate. 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not. 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have. description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. 🚀 The Adventure Ahead As the founding Manager of Product Consulting, you will build and lead a trailblazing regional team of product experts who design directly alongside our Customer Account Executives. This is your chance to set the global standard for how we deliver customer value, keeping your own product skills razor-sharp in everything from advanced AI workflows to complex integrations. You'll architect a repeatable, scalable model that empowers your consultants to turn cutting-edge platform capabilities into massive customer wins. 🛠️ The Day-to-Day Master the Platform: Dive deep into Docebo’s ecosystem to become the ultimate hands-on expert in new releases, AI capabilities, and complex integrations, serving as a trusted guide for your team. Build the Dream Team: Hire, onboard, and coach a passionate roster of Product Consultants while fostering a high-performance culture rooted in curiosity, accountability, and craft. Architect Global Standards: Drive our global model for project intake, prioritization, and quality, ensuring every customer engagement is tied to a measurable goal before work even begins. Elevate the Craft: Enable your team with ongoing training, reusable design patterns, and best practices to keep everyone at the cutting edge of our evolving technology. Own the Outcomes: Monitor delivery quality across your team's portfolio, stepping in to review high-risk plans while empowering your consultants to confidently own their final work. Drive Commercial Success: Partner with Customer Account Executives to flawlessly demo new modules in the customer’s unique context, directly supporting strategic upsell conversations. Bridge the Gap: Act as a crucial feedback loop between customers and our Product, Engineering, and Solutions teams to continuously refine our offerings and shape the platform's future. 🦸 Your Superpowers Lead with Experience: You bring 6+ years in Solutions Consulting, Implementation, or Professional Services, backed by meaningful experience mentoring or leading customer-facing professionals. Configure with Confidence: You possess advanced, hands-on expertise in SaaS discovery and integrations, treating the platform as something to master rather than just manage. Coach to Greatness: You grow your people by developing their own judgment and critical thinking, rather than just solving their problems for them. Communicate with Impact: You have stellar operational and prioritization skills, paired with the emotional intelligence to read the room and navigate complex constraints without losing trust. Pioneer the Path: You are a natural trailblazer who thrives in ambiguity, bringing the strategic judgment necessary to influence senior partners and build solutions from the ground up. ⭐ Bonus Points Navigate the Globe: Experience leading distributed teams across various regions and time zones. Know the Ecosystem: A background in LMS, HR technology, EdTech, or enterprise learning software. Embrace the Future: Hands-on experience building or testing AI agents, knowledge collections, or AI-powered workflows. Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝 Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing. Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. Our Promise to You 😍 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! Family First : We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long. About Docebo 💙 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs ( TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO ), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection —that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer . title: Account Manager, Partnerships
description: 🏷️ Title: Account Manager, Partnerships 👫 Department: Commercial 💰 Salary: £55,000 - £65,000 📄 Contract: Permanent 🎁 Benefits & Culture: See here 📈 Equity: A very generous EMI share offering 🌴 Holiday: 26 days + bank holidays 💗 Mission: Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future 💻 Office Policy: Hybrid with a minimum of 2 core office days per week 🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK 🔍 The Opportunity: Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care, changing how the UK finds, manages and pays for care. Most families start looking in a crisis, and many turn first to someone they already trust: their employer, council, the NHS or a charity. We want Lottie to be where those organisations send them. Partnerships already bring families to Lottie . Through Seniorcare by Lottie, large employers give their people expert support when a relative needs care. Referral partners like Kinly introduce families to our marketplace. You'll own these partnerships and build the next wave. About half your time goes on growing existing partners, and half on opening new ones across the public sector (like local authorities) and the private and charity sectors. We're early, so you'll shape the proposition from the ground up. You'll be an individual contributor reporting to our VP Commercial, Matt Morgan. Success means enquiries from your partnerships and, ultimately, families placed in care. 💻 What does this role involve? Own our relationships with the employers who use Seniorcare by Lottie , acting as their senior point of contact, keeping them engaged and maintaining the number of employees who use the service. Take over our marketplace referral partnerships , including Kinly, managing performance, commercials and the quality of the enquiries they refer. Build and run a pipeline of new demand-generating partnerships for the marketplace, exploring local authorities, the NHS and national old age charities. Design the commercial model for each new partnership, from referral fees to co-marketing, and negotiate the terms. Track enquiries and placements by partner , so we know which partnerships are working and where to invest next. Work with our Care Experts, marketing and product teams to make every partner referral a great experience for the family and easy for the partner. 💪 What problems will you be solving? When a parent suddenly needs care, most families don't start with Google. They ask their employer, their GP or their council. Your job is to make Lottie the first place those organisations think of. A partnership is only as valuable as the families it brings. You'll make sure partner referrals turn into placements, not just leads. Local authorities, the NHS and charities work to different incentives, budgets and timelines from commercial partners. You'll work out where Lottie genuinely helps them , from easing pressure on hospital discharge to supporting families who fund their own care, and build partnerships that last. 👀 We think you’ll be a great fit if… You have experience in partnerships, business development or account management, ideally in a marketplace, employee benefits, health or care business. You've grown existing partners and landed new ones from scratch. You're commercially minded : you think in volume, conversion and unit economics, and you're comfortable negotiating terms. You build credibility quickly with very different people, from an HR director to a council commissioner. You use AI to stay on top of everything, so a nine-month council deal and your day-to-day partners both get the attention they need. 💔 This role isn’t for you if… You're not passionate about elevating later life for everybody - our mission is at the heart of everything we do. You only want to manage existing relationships, or only want to hunt new ones. This role is both. You need quick wins to stay motivated. Some partnerships will take many months to land, and we measure them by the families they bring, not logos signed. You're not up for using AI and process improvement to move fast in a growing startup. 📝 Application We'd love to see a short video (about 2 minutes) answering this question: Introduce yourself and tell us why you're interested in Lottie and why you feel you'd be a good fit for the role. Launched in London in July 2021, Lottie has raised over £25m from tier 1 venture capital funds (Accel and General Catalyst) and is widely recognised as one of the UK's fastest growing tech companies. Most recently, Lottie was the acclaimed winner of Deloitte Fast 50 , LinkedIn Top Startups , The Sunday Times Tech 2026 and Startups.co.uk Startups 100 . As of today, Lottie offers three core products: Lottie (B2B2C Marketplace) - Free service that helps families find the UK's best care homes and home care services. Found by Lottie (B2B Vertical SaaS) - AI-native OS software supporting care providers to effectively manage their enquiries, occupancy and finances. Care is one of the final remaining large consumer industries yet to be disrupted and positively revolutionised by technology. description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role * Open to hiring in London, UK. Runway is scaling its Enterprise revenue organization with leaders who know how to build and scale high-performance teams. And, who can operate a revenue machine while keeping customer value in mind - leading our industry-based revenue pods responsible for both net-new ACV, NRR, and Renewal. This role is designed for the leader who wants to accelerate their CRO career trajectory. The role calls for breadth across commercial contracting, corporate governance, IP and compliance rather than depth in any one of them. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based in our office in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting its export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> governance — listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls — gained either as counsel inside a listed company or on a listing process.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO from preparation to admission.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Software Engineer, Prime
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Join us in building the future of finance.</h2> <p>Our mission is to democratize finance for all. <a href="https://www.cerulli.com/press-releases/cerulli-anticipates-124-trillion-in-wealth-will-transfer-through-2048" target="_blank">An estimated $124 trillion of assets</a> will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.</p></div><h2>About the team + role</h2> <p>We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems.<strong> </strong>We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. </p> <p>The <strong>Prime team's</strong> mission is to build Bitstamp's prime brokerage for institutional clients — the platform that lets hedge funds, market makers, and professional trading firms fund, trade, borrow against, and settle positions at scale. We build the systems that move real institutional money: cross-venue settlement, credit against collateral, matched-book lending, and the bridge that brings tokenized securities to our order book. These are correctness-critical systems where a wrong answer can't be cheaply undone — getting them right is the whole job.</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Backend Engineer</strong> to join our team. As a Backend Engineer, you will lead the backend development process for core components and build services from inception to deployment. This individual will be helping solve correctness, scaling, and reliability challenges on a backend-first, high-performance, and world-class institutional trading platform.</p> <p><strong>This role is based in our London office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. </strong></p> <p>At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. </p> <p><strong>Requires participation in an on-call rotation to support business needs.</strong></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design and ship production services: Implement and operate resilient backend services and subsystems that move institutional money — contributing to flows such as cross-venue settlement, collateral credit, matched-book lending, and order execution.</li> <li>Author focused technical specs: Draft clear technical designs for new features and components, explicitly defining data invariants, error handling, state boundaries, and recovery mechanisms before writing code.</li> <li>Build for failure: Write clean, idiomatic, and thoroughly tested code, pairing production features with rigorous unit/integration tests, sensible monitoring, structured logging, and targeted alerts.</li> <li>Maintain operational health: Actively participate in the team's on-call rotation, debug production anomalies, and contribute to blameless post-mortems and remediation work to harden our platform.</li> <li>Collaborate and review: Participate in architectural discussions and provide thoughtful, constructive code reviews to help maintain high code quality and consistency across the team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven backend track record: Solid experience independently designing, implementing, and maintaining backend services in a production environment, taking full ownership of what you ship.</li> <li>Correctness-critical mindset: Hands-on experience with financial, transactional, or distributed systems (e.g., payments, ledgers, trading, order management, or inventory engines) where data integrity is paramount and mistakes are costly.</li> <li>Systems fundamentals: Strong understanding of distributed systems and transactional boundaries, including relational data modeling (PostgreSQL), data consistency, idempotency, and asynchronous workflows/message queues.</li> <li>Defensive engineering: Good design judgment and an instinct to test failure paths; you think title: Management Consulting, Director - Logistics  & Supply Chain Transformation
description: <p><strong>The Management Consulting Team at Teneo</strong></p> <p>Our Management Consulting division focuses on answering key strategic questions for business and public-sector leaders through our mix of senior experience and rigorous analysis, combined with the unique expertise that exists across Teneo. We operate across a diverse array of sectors including Consumer Goods, Healthcare, Leisure & Hospitality, Software, Transport, and TMT, amongst others. Within these markets, we provide strategic, operational, and due diligence support, advising reputable FTSE 100 and Fortune 500 firms, key public-sector organisations, and leading private equity houses.  </p> <p><strong>Key Attributes</strong></p> <p>As a Director in our Logistics & Supply Chain Transformation team, you'll be a senior management consultant who combines deep logistics and supply chain transformation expertise with strong client leadership and commercial capability. You will lead complex client engagements, build trusted relationships with senior executives, originate and convert new opportunities, and play an active role in growing our Logistics & Supply Chain Transformation capability.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex logistics and supply chain transformation engagements, taking overall responsibility for the quality of the answer, senior client relationship and successful delivery of outcomes</li> <li>Advise senior clients on complex logistics and supply chain challenges, structuring rigorous analysis, developing the answer and translating insight into pragmatic transformation initiatives that deliver measurable operational and financial impact</li> <li>Develop the client 'answer' from initial hypothesis through refinement and validation, leading the development of robust recommendations, business cases, implementation roadmaps and transformation programmes</li> <li>Lead work across our core Logistics & Supply Chain Transformation topics, including logistics and distribution strategy, network optimisation, transport and warehousing, fulfilment and final mile, S&OP and planning, cost-to-serve and productivity improvement, operating model redesign and transformation implementation</li> <li>Lead and develop high-performing consulting teams, setting clear direction, maintaining exceptional standards of analytical and written output, and coaching Managers and junior colleagues to develop their consulting and sector capabilities</li> <li>Identify and convert new opportunities, lead proposals and pitches, deepen existing client relationships and contribute directly to the commercial growth of the Logistics & Supply Chain Transformation team</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with C-suite, Board and senior operational stakeholders, acting as a credible adviser on logistics and supply chain performance, transformation priorities and difficult implementation decisions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Skills & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant relevant professional experience, ideally including substantial experience within Strategy or Management Consulting, with a strong track record leading logistics and supply chain transformation engagements</li> <li>Deep expertise in logistics and supply chain transformation, with consulting experience across several of the following: logistics and distribution strategy, network optimisation, transport strategy and optimisation, warehousing and distribution centre design or improvement, fulfilment and final mile, S&OP and planning, cost-to-serve, productivity and operating model transformation</li> <li>Strong transformation credentials - able to move from diagnosis and strategy through business case development, programme mobilisation and implementation, with a track record of delivering measurable operational and financial benefits</li> <li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge complex operational issues, direct bespoke analysis and translate detailed findings into clear strategic recommendations for senior clients</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement and a deep understanding of the operational and economic levers within logistics and supply chain, including service, capacity, inventory, labour, transport, network and cost trade-offs</li> <li>Excellent communication and senior client leadership skills, with the credibility to influence C-suite, Board and senior operational stakeholders and lead compelling executive-level discussions and presentations</li> <li>Demonstrable commercial capability, with experience developing senior client relationships, identifying opportunities and contributing to the origination and conversion of consulting work</li> <li>Evidence of leadership and capability building, including leading and developing consulting teams and contributing to propositions, thought leadership and intellectual property in logistics and supply chain transformation</li> <li>Experience working across multiple sectors where logistics and supply chain performance is a material value driver - for example Consumer, Retail, Industrials, Manufacturing, Business Services, Transport & Logistics or Healthcare</li> <li>Experience of technology-enabled logistics and supply chain transformation - such as WMS, advanced planning, analytics, automation or decision-support tools - is advantageous where it supports broader operational transformation</li> <li>Exposure to Private Equity, including operational due diligence and/or post-deal value creation in logistics and supply chain, is advantageous but not required</li> <li>Degree qualified (2.1 or above preferred) in any discipline; a relevant engineering, operations, supply chain or quantitative background is advantageous</li> <li>Operates at a fast pace, demonstrates entrepreneurialism and ownership, and can confidently influence and challenge senior stakeholders while maintaining strong client relationships</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Teneo </strong></p> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organisations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG.</p> <p>The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Agent Harness Engineer
description: About us: Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes. We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making. Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence. About the team We’re hiring AI engineers to help us transform research outcomes in biomedical sciences. We utilise generative AI and agents to help scientists find novel connections and insights from biomedical literature and datasets. Delivering a faster research experience is not just a matter of picking the latest LLM model. Getting accurate, scientifically relevant, trustworthy and meaningful results relies on building trust with our users that comes from integrating proper levels of guardrails, biomedical curation, consistent update cycles and robust deployment practices that make our platform a one-stop shop for a researcher’s needs. We’re looking for AI engineers who will champion this cause and help us apply AI to transform the way biomedical professionals carry out their research and day-to-day exploration. What you’ll be doing Design and implement AI agents end-to-end, from the first idea to deployment and monitoring, balancing cutting-edge techniques with pragmatism to deliver measurable impact. Apply strong software engineering principles, such as modularity, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and observability, to ensure AI systems are reliable, maintainable, production-ready and can be readily adapted to future developments. Choose the right approach for the problem at hand, evaluating different models, prompts, tools and agent designs to balance trade-offs between speed, cost, complexity, interpretability, and performance. Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to scope work, align on success metrics, and incrementally ship improvements in user-facing features powered by AI. Document system architectures and decision rationale early and clearly, enabling alignment across teams and accelerating onboarding and iteration. Champion model and data quality, including robust evaluation, hallucination checks, and real-world performance tracking. Mentor junior AI engineers and cross-functional teammates, sharing best practices in modelling, coding, maintaining and integrating product features, and helping grow a high-trust, high-performance team culture. Stay up-to-date with emerging research and tools, distilling key insights and bringing back relevant innovations to elevate team capabilities and product opportunities. Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, through company-wide Slack channels, Show and Tell presentations and technical deep-dives. What experience you’ll need to be successful A master's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 5+ years of experience building software in production environments, including LLM-based systems, with ownership of key lifecycle stages: design, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Proficiency in Python and modern agentic frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, with experience integrating LLMs into applications. A solid understanding of LLMs and agents, including topics such as tool use, context management, prompt engineering and evals. Strong software engineering foundations such as version control, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, containerization plus a mindset of building for reliability and scale. Experience working in product-focused teams, collaborating with designers, engineers, and PMs, to scope and ship AI features iteratively Ability to reason about system behaviour end-to-end, including model performance, latency, and observability, and how these impact user experience. Clear, structured communicator, comfortable documenting and defending architectural decisions and engaging in thoughtful technical debate. Not required, but it’s a plus if you also have: Experience with LLMOps frameworks and best practices A PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field. A background or work experience in life-sciences, health-tech, or other data-intensive domains Benefits 💰 Competitive compensation package 🩺 Private medical & dental insurance 📔 Life insurance (4 x salary) 🤓 Personal development budget 🧘 Individual wellbeing budget 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 🥳 Your birthday off! 🚀 Potential to have real impact and accelerated career growth as a member of an international team that's building a transformative AI product. We are on a mission to accelerate scientific breakthroughs for ALL humankind, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and fairly consider qualified candidates without regard to race, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, genetics, age, religion or belief, marital/civil partnership status, domestic / family status, veteran status or any other difference. We believe the future of commerce is warmer, more human than ever - just at a scale no human team could pull off alone. We've raised €7M+ and work with brands like Ducati, Pittarosso, MC2 Saint Barth, and Doppelgänger. We're a lean, fast, Italian-born scale-up now expanding our story internationally and this role is a big part of writing it. The role We're looking for an experienced Business Development Representative to own our outbound motion in the UK . Based in London and working remotely, you'll take full ownership of the process , from picking the accounts to handing over qualified meetings, and building the UK pipeline from the ground up. You'll join our uk team and work closely with Agnese, our Country Launcher. Run multichannel outreach through cold calls, cold emails and LinkedIn, getting to the decision makers at UK B2C and e-commerce brands. Hand over meetings that convert : well prepared, properly qualified, with the right people in the room. Real process ownership : you've built and run your own outbound, not just worked through someone else's sequences. UK-based and native English speaker , both mandatory. Right to work in the UK. Confidence on the phone and with senior stakeholders: you enjoy conversations and know how to keep them going. Autonomy and drive : you plan your own week, work well remotely and keep your CRM clean without being asked. Nice to have : experience selling to Marketing, CRM or Ecommerce Managers at B2C brands, or a network in UK ecommerce. Why TextYess Real ownership, from day one. No layers, no waiting your turn: you'll own outcomes, not just tasks. Lean team, big impact. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with top-notch international talent, ready to disrupt and leave a mark. Build, don't maintain. We're early enough that most of what you touch doesn't have a playbook yet, you get to write it. Grow as fast as you push. Roles and responsibilities scale with what you prove you can do, not with tenure. A team that actually likes each other. We're a dynamic, close-knit crew that moves fast, laughs a lot, and has each other's backs. Our hiring process We keep it real and reasonably fast: Screening call , let's just talk. Communication, fit, the basics. Interview + role play , you'll pitch TextYess to a decision maker, with a brief shared in advance. Founder & Team conversations , here you meet the people you'd actually work with. Debrief, reference check, and decision . We move quickly once we're there. Sound like you? If you want to own something real from day one and help write TextYess' growth story in the UK, we want to meet you! TextYess is an equal opportunity employer. title: Sales Manager, SMB
description: Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable. Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners. It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives. How we work Four principles guide us: Velocity. Optimize for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better. Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it’s inconvenient. Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative. End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through. The role Our EMEA sales team is growing quickly, and we’re hiring a Sales Manager to report to the Director of Sales, EMEA and help us build the leadership and operating foundations for the next stage of scale. Key ownership areas: Own the performance and quota of the SMB segment. Recruit, lead, coach, and develop a growing team of quota-carrying sellers, reinforcing a high bar for execution. Strong coaching and talent-development skills, with a track record of raising the performance bar for sellers. Systems thinking: you can translate ambitious growth goals into clear processes, reporting, and team rhythms. Excellent customer-facing judgment and the ability to support sellers in complex commercial conversations. Experience in mid-market, SMB, or building a new regional sales motion; expertise in any one of these can be a strong fit. High agency, high standards, and the comfort to operate in an environment where there is still a great deal to build. What we offer The best co-workers you’ll ever have, in an environment that fosters cohesion, collaboration, and performance. Supreme rate-of-learning as we re-orient how the world works with AI. description: HEADLINE: Job Title: Legal Counsel Reporting to: General Counsel Location: London - Hybrid-Working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home ABOUT THE ROLE: APEXX is pioneering payment orchestration, transforming the global payments landscape with cutting-edge technology and innovation. As a leader in Fintech, we're committed to excellence, driving forward-thinking solutions that empower businesses worldwide. We are looking for a Legal Counsel to join APEXX’s Legal & Compliance team, providing front-line guidance and support across all areas of the business. You will work closely with our General Counsel and wider business to support a broad range of commercial and legal matters, gaining significant exposure to the day to day operations of a fast-paced, international FinTech. This is a generalist role offering a high level of commercial involvement. WHAT YOU’LL DOING: This is a hands-on, commercially focused role supporting the General Counsel with several key elements including: Reviewing, drafting and negotiating a range of complex commercial agreements Delivering legal and strategic advice to different areas of the business on a variety of matters ranging from financial regulation and the payments ecosystem, contracts, negotiations, documentation, client issues, employment, compliance, IP, IT, marketing and data protection Supporting the commercial teams and wider business in discussions with customers, partners and suppliers Identifying legal and regulatory risks related to the introduction of new products and expansion into new markets Helping to identify, prepare and deliver training to the business on relevant legal and commercial issues Delivering continuous improvement in operating practices and processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement ABOUT YOU: You’ve done this before : You’ll be a qualified lawyer with some post qualification experience (1-2+ years PQE) ideally working within Startups, FinTech or Payments. You have sound judgement: The ability to provide sound legal advice and exercise good business judgement and to promptly identify, analyse and mitigate risks and issues within the business while maximising commercial opportunities. You think creatively: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to confidently work with stakeholders across the business to achieve objectives. You communicate effectively: Communication is key to the role including being able to advise stakeholders across all parts of the business on challenging legal issues in layman’s terms. You have passion and drive: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high level of competing tasks and tight deadlines and to be adaptable, coping with change quickly. You’re in the detail: Thoroughness and accuracy are pivotal to your role including in drafting, advising on, and negotiating commercial agreements and researching legal issues. You lead from the front: This is a hands-on role, and you will be expected to handle significant and complex legal matters and provide direction across the business, including to senior level stakeholders. GREAT TO HAVE: You know our domain : Expertise and experience in financial services particularly regulation and licensing processes for the payments industry, with the ability to keep up to date with and share relevant legal and market developments. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS: Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond. Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX. 💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make. 🏖️ Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work. 🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy.* ❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance which includes optical & dental to help support you when it matters most. 🛡️ Life Insurance & Critical Illness Protection: Additional protection for you and your loved ones when it’s needed most. 👶 Enhanced Family Leave : Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies. 📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX. WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE: APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration. Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers , helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence. Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2 , we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX. To learn more about APEXX and experience the dynamics of being part of our team, feel free to check out the provided media channels below: LinkedIn : https://www.linkedin.com/company/apexxglobal/ Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/apexx.global/?hl=en Main Website : https://apexx.global/ APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to encouraging equality, diversity, and inclusion among our employees and eliminating discrimination. We do not accept speculative CVs or candidate profiles from Recruitment Agencies. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
company: How We Work & What We Value - Ashby
description: Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success. We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward. Role overview: We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you. As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team. Role requirements: UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates. Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place. People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit. Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint. Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently. Compensation Expertise : You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions. Performance Management : You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles. Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees. Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk. You could be a great fit if: 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions. ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence Bonus points if you have: An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification This role may not be a fit if: You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. While past experience is valuable, you'll need to apply principled thinking to assess what would work well for Ashby. Working independently feels uncomfortable and you require a significant amount of guidance in how to perform your job. Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments. You prefer working with a single team instead of multiple teams. Interview process Our interview process is thorough. We want to make sure everyone who joins is the right fit for Ashby, and we'll give you plenty of information to decide whether Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is: Recruiter screen with the Talent Acquisition team (30 minutes) People Ops team interview (45 minutes) Take-home assignment (1 hour) People Leader interview (45 minutes) Virtual onsite (2–3 hours) Benefits Competitive salary and equity. 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby -do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited holiday with five weeks recommended per year on top of UK bank holidays. Expect "Holiday?" on our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅 A generous budget for equipment, software, and office furniture. Get what you need to be happy and productive! Top-notch supplemental health insurance (private medical and dental) for you and your dependents, with premiums covered by us, plus company-paid life insurance + income protection, and a workplace pension with a 3% Ashby contribution. Generous family leave. You'll get your full statutory family leave entitlement, and Ashby pays the first 12 weeks at 100%. £100/month education budget, with bigger items (like conferences) covered with manager approval. Ashby's success depends on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We're being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply. Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position. Compensation: £100K – £135K • Offers Equity • £100K – £135K • Offers Equity Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise
description: TL;DR – We’re looking for Staff Software Engineers to join the team and build Lovable for our Enterprise customers. Your time will be split between customer engagements and building our core product. Up to 40% of your time could be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers to solve their hardest technical problems. The rest you’ll spend back in the product team, building what you’ve learned in the field into the Lovable platform. It’s a unique opportunity to work on both sides of enterprise software and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. About the role Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both. You'll build the parts of Lovable that Enterprise level companies depend on: security, governance, admin controls, integrations with their existing systems, and performance at scale. Up to 40% of your time you’ll be forward deployed, working directly with enterprise customers on their hardest technical problems. The rest of the time you’ll be back in the product team, building what the field showed you. The aim of every rotation is to turn what one customer needs into something every customer can use. If you want to stay deeply hands-on, close to both real customer problems and the product that solves them, this is that role. Forward Deployed rotations may involve travel to customer sites. What you’ll do Build and ship core enterprise capabilities across Lovable’s frontend, backend and AI systems, and operate them in production Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems Spend up-to 40% of your time forward deployed with enterprise customers, solving their hardest technical problems Turn what you learned in the field into foundational platform improvements Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries Shape how the Enterprise team runs its field rotations, including engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations What we’re looking for 8+ years experience building, shipping and maintaining production-grade software Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including robust backend (Go, Rust) development and React and TypeScript on the frontend You have worked directly with customers, and have the product sense to tell a one-off request from something every customer needs Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems Experience building for enterprise requirements such as SSO, role-based access control, audit logging, data residency or compliance Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions Bonus if you’ve: Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before Led zero-to-one product development Worked in a forward deployed, solutions, or partner engineering role Worked in a founding or early startup environment Our Tech Stack Backend: Golang & Rust Frontend: React, Typescript Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more How we hire Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team. Complete a quick live coding exercise. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews. Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud. About your application Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal. Across our Product, Engineering, Design and Intelligence we’re going beyond giving everyone the tools. We’re setting new standards. Using AI to transform how we build and work every day to deliver on our market opportunity. title: Technical Programme Manager, Security Engineering (Risk)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2><strong>The deadline for applying to this role is Wednesday 25th November 2026, end of day (UK Time).</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As the models we test get more capable and the environments we run them in get more sensitive, we have to continue to be able to run evaluations of highly capable models under proper control and ensure that it remains governed well. Building that governance and keeping it fast is what lets AISI keep pace with the work in front of it.<br><br>The Security Engineering team keeps AISI's research platform, evaluation environments, and sensitive data secure, and runs the governance, risk, and compliance around them. We harden the environments evaluations run in, detect and respond to threats, and build the controls that let evaluations of highly capable models proceed safely. We work with research teams across AISI, with partners in frontier AI companies and government.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Rigorous safety governance and fast-moving research aren't mutually exclusive. AISI research involves working with highly capable AI models, often before they have been released to the public and often with lowered safeguards, to understand their true capabilities. That work has to be properly controlled, and someone has to build the processes and systems that help us make the call that it's safe to run without becoming a bottleneck. We're hiring a Technical Programme Manager in Security Engineering to own the AISI-wide governance mechanism that oversees these safety judgements, the controls research teams work under, and every edge case and escalation in between. You'll work with the team's engineers and the researchers whose work this governs.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll own:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>AISI-wide Governance Mechanism that oversees safety. </strong>Own the process, make clear what it approves and how, help people work through their requirements proactively, and keep decisions well-evidenced and moving.</li> <li><strong>The research/control interface. </strong>You'll own how research teams meet the security controls that apply to their work, and the defined path for handling the exceptions.</li> <li><strong>Programme architecture and delivery. </strong>You'll track the team's work and spot problems early, with enough visibility to stay in control.</li> <li><strong>Cross-government governance engagement. </strong>You'll represent AISI on governance and risk with partners across government, including the Cabinet Office, building the relationships, and turning departmental policy into AISI process.<strong><br></strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who we're looking for</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Essential experience:</strong></h3> <p>You may be a good fit if you have some of the following skills, experience and attitudes:</p> <ul> <li><strong>A track record with technical colleagues. </strong>You've delivered technical programmes somewhere similarly ambiguous. You can scope and structure an open-ended goal. Technical teams trust you.</li> <li><strong>Comfort at the frontier of AI. </strong>You don't have to be an ML researcher, but you need to hold your own in constant conversation with technical staff about the work, the strategy, and the risks. You should have a view on what's hard, what's speculative, what's blocked, and what "good" looks like.</li> <li><strong>High agency and ownership.</strong> You own outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>Strong prioritisation under pressure. </strong>You can tell what actually matters day to day and quarter to quarter.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable experience:</strong></h3> <p>Strong candidates may also have:</p> <ul> <li>Experience in security, risk, or GRC. A technical background with a genuine interest in security is ideal but not required.</li> <li>Fluency in, or appetite for, modern productivity tools (coding agents, Linear, Slack) and AI tools as part of daily work.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. We care more about what you've broken, and how, than about certifications or job titles. </strong></p> <h2><strong>Selection process </strong></h2> <p>The interview process may vary from vacancy to vacancy, however, you should expect a typical process to include some technical proficiency tests, discussions with a cross-section of our team at AISI (including non-technical staff) and conversations with your team lead. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <h2><strong>The deadline for applying to this role is Tuesday 8th December, </strong><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">end of day, anywhere on Earth</span></span></strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Red Team conducts cutting-edge research to identify, evaluate and stress test vulnerabilities in frontier AI systems, sharing our findings directly with leading AI companies, UK officials and allied governments. Our work shapes how the most powerful AI systems are deployed - you can read about it in the <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/24/technology/uk-ai-safety-institute.html">The New York Times</a>, <a href="https://www.economist.com/britain/2026/02/19/britain-is-the-closest-the-world-has-to-an-ai-safety-inspector">The Economist,</a> and <a href="https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2026/04/22/32-year-old-wunderkind-preparing-britain-ai-attack/">The Telegraph</a>. Demand for this work is growing faster than we can currently meet - we're scaling to address that gap. </p> <p><span data-contrast="none">The Red Team’s work is crucial to ensuring advanced AI systems are developed and deployed safely.
